row.name: capacity_hourly_rate
row.rationale: Loaded cost of a triage handler

input.residual_explanation: Both initiatives release time of the same accounts-payable team; the larger claim is counted once and the overlap is listed.

injections.defect: init-009 (Complaint triage routing) has released capacity as its only benefit; a row claims 100 of those hours as realised cash, with no capacity_hourly_rate and no staffing change evidence.
injections.expected_handling: The claim is refused CAPACITY_WITHOUT_CONVERSION; the hours stay out of the cash flow (listed as not converted, NPV from costs alone); a derived cash item exists only after a conversion assumption with a staffing change evidence reference, and then as a separate item citing it, in a scenario built after that assumption existed (a scenario keeps the assumptions it was built on).
injections.name: time savings booked as cash without a staffing change

injections.defect: init-001 and init-002 both claim the time of the same accounts-payable team (benefit_source_key src-fin-ap-shared-team); with the capacity converted (rate pinned from May) the portfolio adds both claims.
injections.expected_handling: The claims sharing a key in a period count once, at the larger claim; the rest is the double-count residual with the overlaps listed; select-scenario is refused DOUBLE_COUNT_UNEXPLAINED until the residual is explained (in money or in hours, with an explanation of at least 20 characters); the portfolio NPV is the attributable one, the sum of the initiative NPVs less the present value of the claim that counts twice; a scenario without an overlap in money or in hours (for example scn-026, the portfolio without init-002) has both residuals at 0.00 and can be proposed without an explanation.
injections.name: two initiatives claim the same released capacity

injections.defect: A scenario declares an annual discount rate of 0.08 on monthly periods and cites no conversion.
injections.expected_handling: Refused RATE_PERIOD_MISMATCH, never applied raw; an annual rate is accepted only with its recorded conversion (1 + r)^(1/12) - 1, a declared six-place assumption version (0.006434 for 0.08), and the scenario then reports the converted rate and its source.
injections.name: an annual rate applied to monthly periods

injections.defect: A cash benefit for init-005 starts in period 7, three periods before its deployment period 10.
injections.expected_handling: Refused BENEFIT_BEFORE_DEPLOYMENT; every benefit stream of the world starts at or after deployment (lag 0 to 2) and the adoption ramp, indexed from each row's own starts_period, is applied beside the unramped plan.
injections.name: a benefit before deployment

injections.defect: init-003: nearly everyone completed training (see the figures) while adoption stalled; rows that restate training completion as adoption are offered.
injections.expected_handling: Adoption and training stay two series: the adoption rate comes only from adoption observations on the initiative's eligibility rule, training completion beside it, substituted_for_adoption false and differs_from_adoption true; the substitution rows are refused (ELIGIBILITY_RULE_MISMATCH, ADOPTED_EXCEEDS_ELIGIBLE).
injections.name: training completion substituted for adoption

injections.defect: After the target was missed, a row rewrites version 1 of the init-003 forecast instead of adding a revision.
injections.expected_handling: Refused VERSION_EXISTS (the database also refuses UPDATE and DELETE); a revision is the next version and restates every period of the original (a partial one is REVISION_PERIODS_INCOMPLETE), the original approved version 1 stays unchanged and the comparison lists the original, every revision and the observed values with their dates.
injections.name: a forecast overwrite

injections.defect: init-001 is asked to depend on init-004 which already depends (through init-002) on it.
injections.expected_handling: Refused DEPENDENCY_CYCLE with the cycle listed from the rejected edge's initiative; the 40 dependencies of the world form no cycle and every initiative has a feasible start, the dependency delay reported beside the requested start.
injections.name: a dependency cycle

injections.defect: init-015 (Carrier booking automation) recovers about 62 % of its cost over its benefit window; a presentation shows a payback period anyway.
injections.expected_handling: Simple and discounted payback are null (not 0, not rejected) in every scenario that holds it, with a negative NPV; a longer horizon does not create a payback because the benefits end with the window; the page says it does not pay back within the horizon.
injections.name: a case that never pays back presented with a payback

injections.defect: res-03 (2.00 FTE) is already allocated to capacity in periods 14, 15 and 16; init-012 asks for 0.50 more in each.
injections.expected_handling: Each request is refused RESOURCE_OVERALLOCATED with its period (a sum equal to capacity is allowed); the refused rows are kept in the replay events; the stored allocations show 2.00 allocated and 0.00 headroom in those periods and no overallocated period.
injections.name: a shared specialist overallocated

injections.defect: The cash benefit of init-008 (Knowledge-assisted contact handling) is close to plan, and a client claims all of it for the rollout; most of it is the trend that was already under way.
injections.expected_handling: An observed improvement is compared with the baseline trend recorded before deployment and reported as 'observed, not attributed'; the share above the trend sits beside the raw change, never in place of it; a claim of full attribution is refused ATTRIBUTION_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
injections.name: an improvement attributed entirely to the rollout

injections.defect: The one-time cost ck-001-licence-setup-1 (13500.00, period 1) is entered again 4 periods later.
injections.expected_handling: The repeat is refused ONE_TIME_COST_REPEATED and the first row is kept; a cost that really recurs is a recurring row over an explicit half-open range, expanded one row per period by the command that builds the cash flows; no cost key of the world repeats as a one-time cost.
injections.name: a one-time cost that recurs

injections.defect: init-002 avoids cost that no budget line removed; init-003 says its avoided cost is realised but cites no evidence; init-001 removed a budget line and cites it.
injections.expected_handling: Avoided cost enters the cash flow only when cash_realisation is true and an evidence_ref names the budget line removed (NPV of the evidenced item inside); the rest is reported beside the cash flow (NOT_CASH_REALISED, NO_EVIDENCE_REF) with its total, never added and never refused.
injections.name: cost avoidance added to realised cash savings
